description.value: The Barkley Cafe is a family-run cafe in Davison Plaza on Peninsula Road in the heart of Ucluelet, on the west coast of Vancouver Island. It serves fresh-to-order breakfast and lunch — including sandwiches, house-baked goods, and specialty coffees from Victoria-based Caffe Fantastico — with a notable commitment to sustainability including composting coffee grounds in an on-site herb garden. A warm, welcoming stop with both dine-in and grab-and-go options suited to cyclists passing through.

address.value: Unit 1-1620 Peninsula Rd, Davison Plaza, Ucluelet BC V0R 3A0
